edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Chronic hyperglycemia injures peripheral nerves through glycation, oxidative stress, and microvascular ischemia, a classic neuropathy pathway.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2020 Wang systematic review in Front Endocrinol (Lausanne), which ties high hba1c to peripheral neuropathy in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
